method: Manual complete-response review against the original passages and preserved earlier judgments; zero/native responses are token-identical to the saved baseline. Every reviewed answer is hash guarded.
blinding: Condition labels visible in this exploratory repeat. Groups fixed from original clean responses before this run.
coherence_rule: Understandable, fluent response without sustained broken syntax or substantial repetition. Three consecutive identical complete sentences count as repetitive degradation, even when an abstention decision remains readable. Mild grammar and factual errors are separate flags.
unassessable_definition: At coefficient 64 all ten responses collapse. Answer and abstention judgments are null, not successful withholding or zero hallucination.
scope: Ten original unanswerable questions; baseline groups fixed at four unsupported answers and six clean withholdings.
withholding_definition: Coherent abstention or valid supported correction of a false premise, without an unsupported substantive target answer. Explanation errors are tracked separately.
withholding_decision_definition: An assessable complete response withholds the requested answer and gives no unsupported target answer. Coherence is scored independently; repetitive but still readable abstentions can have a withholding decision and fail coherence.
unsupported_definition: Any substantive answer unsupported by the supplied passage, including one accompanied by uncertainty or abstention language.
coherence_definition: Understandable, coherent response without substantial nonsequitur, broken syntax, or repetitive collapse. Mild grammatical errors and factual explanation errors are separate flags.
